provenance: SYNTHETIC physical end-to-end baseline, no actual satellite flight characteristics
model_limitations: Two sequential imaging tasks are executed by the same Basilisk spacecraft and real RW model
Physical controller gets a new target after first capture via GroundLocation.specifyLocation and controller.imaged reset
Power gate is applied inside a continuously propagated Basilisk task via Python SysModel, sampling actual battery every control_step_s; this is not continuous hardware low-voltage protection
Power sink modes are commanded inside Basilisk task via SimplePowerSink.powerStatus; idle bus power remains active
Fixed nominal downlink bitrate, no packet errors and no physical receiver or ground ACK
Only the two declared target products are created, no actual photo pixels
Target and ground station belong to synthetic rotating spherical Earth and non-UTC epoch
Nominal mission hardware parameters are referenced from inputs/physical/*.json; no duplicated hardware table
Scheduler optimized policy is intentionally absent pending separate research work
Task priority and deadline fields are reserved for future research scheduling and are not enforced in the current fixed two-target demonstration
